rationale: The unified BioEmu cohort contains non-random train-only toxicity signal, especially for 31-50 aa peptides.
BioEmu and the legacy generators remain strongly distinguishable on identical samples, so legacy-source-trained 3D components are not directly transferable.
The fixed BioEmu descriptor classifier is complementary on only 9 of 66 disagreements and is substantially weaker than the frozen 1D OOF anchor.
The 200-row evidence does not establish incremental OOF benefit sufficient to justify approximately 90 additional GPU hours.
next_authorized_stage: retain the verified 200-row pilot as a research artifact; any expansion requires a preregistered bounded fusion method that beats the fixed 1D anchor without using Test1/Test2
